script_text: Stop! Taurus, the cosmos is igniting a destructive firestorm in your personal arena right now. Mercury is forming a harsh square to your ruling planet Venus, creating chaotic friction in your 7th House of Partnerships. As an Earth sign, this celestial pressure is testing your core patience, forcing you to confront deeply suppressed emotions head-on today. If taken, a heated argument with your partner is unavoidable unless you choose diplomacy over pure defensiveness. Meanwhile, Jupiter is aligning with your Sun in your 10th House of Career, signaling a sudden but solid promotion opportunity that requires bold action. Beware of impulsive luxury purchases, as Mars is transiting your 2nd House of Finances, tempting you to overspend. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you can secure your fortune.
